# Evidence map: F13 metric prevalence (generated by make_f13.py; do not edit)

Plotted variable: number of direct papers (of 45) with at least one metric definition in the family.
Source matrix: `07_Literature_Analysis/evaluation_metrics_matrix.csv`.
Families are assigned by the documented keyword patterns in `11_Tables/build_tables.py` (table T8) and written to `11_Tables/T8_evaluation_metrics.csv`, which this script reads. The level grouping and the "what it cannot show" text are the curated T8 columns. No value is typed by hand.

| Level group | Metric family | Numerator (direct papers) | Denominator | Blind spot shown |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Model-level | VLM action / decision accuracy | 10 | 45 | Whether the decision is executable or safe in closed loop |
| Model-level | Text similarity of reasoning | 7 | 45 | Correctness and grounding of the reasoning; robot behaviour |
| Model-level | FM-as-judge / expert-system scores | 3 | 45 | Validity of FM judges; robot behaviour |
| Model or robot | Similarity to human trajectories | 8 | 45 | Perceived naturalness; demonstrator bias |
| Robot-level | Navigation success / efficiency | 23 | 45 | Safety margins, social quality; ≥ 8 incompatible "success" definitions |
| Robot-level | Collision / human-collision rate | 13 | 45 | Near misses and discomfort; definitions vary (counterfactual in MUSON; manual interventions in VLM-Social-Nav) |
| Robot-level | Personal-space violation / compliance | 11 | 45 | Perceived comfort; thresholds differ (0.25 m vs 1.2 m vs Hall bands) |
| Robot-level | Near-collision / risk margin | 7 | 45 | Whether proximity is socially acceptable |
| Robot-level | Rule / instruction / region compliance | 5 | 45 | Whether rules are socially appropriate; task-specific |
| Robot-level | Task-specific social measures | 4 | 45 | Comparability across tasks and papers |
| Robot-level | Smoothness / comfort proxies | 3 | 45 | Human comfort (proxy only) |
| Robot-level | Group-space disruption | 2 | 45 | Group members' perception |
| Human-centred | Human questionnaire ratings | 6 | 45 | Small samples; rarely tested statistically (3/45 papers report any statistics) |
| System / deployment | Runtime / latency | 21 | 45 | End-to-end staleness unless measured with moving humans (SPARK-VLN) |

Generation script: `12_Figures/F13_metric_prevalence/make_f13.py` (pycairo; deterministic).
